title: L2 eigenvalue multiplicities along lambda_m grow without bound on discontinuous AdS3 quotients satisfying the uniform exponential orbit-growth condition
author: Kazuki Kannaka
work: Linear Independence of Generalized Poincaré Series for Anti-de Sitter 3-Manifolds
source_version: Official SIGMA 17 (2021) article 042, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2021.042; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs arbitrarily many independent generalized Poincare series by arranging their angular phases with a lacunary ternary sign pattern. A coefficient-positive polynomial then permits a uniform bound on all nonidentity orbit terms, strictly smaller than the selected identity contribution. This handles linear combinations of functions vanishing at the origin and yields multiplicity growth beyond the earlier nonvanishing result for a single series.

source_check.note: Complete author Theorem3.1 proof and full new independence core Proposition3.2, decay estimate3.3 and phase-sign lemma3.4 are supplied. Gamma is a discontinuous group acting properly discontinuously and freely on AdS3, and condition2.9 requires constants A,a with N_Gamma(x,R)<A exp(aR) uniformly for every x and R>0. The conclusion is lim_m dim_C L2_(lambda_m)(Gamma backslash AdS3)=infinity, where lambda_m=4m(m-1) as fixed in the source. The proof first conjugates Gamma to obtain positive separation via the written Baire argument2.7/2.9 and then gives the explicit threshold m_Gamma(k) and coefficient-tail comparison. Prior existence/L2 convergence of the generalized Poincare series is genuinely established Kassel–Kobayashi background identified in Fact2.4. This is the general exponential-growth statement, not an assertion of infinite multiplicity at each finite m, and it does not assert an elliptic Weyl law. Stable-deformation and orbifold variants are not separately counted. Source approval supplied only by exact frozen root input; no new source/difficulty decision or mathematical referee.

approval_manifest.scope: Complete new lacunary phase/sign construction and positive-polynomial orbit-tail bound for arbitrary finite independent Poincare-series families. Source/artifact/strict final-log checks passed; normalized gate still required.
